articles.title: World : Japan Launches Disaster Management Agency To Boost Response, Reduce Damage
articles.description: TOKYO, Nov 2 (Bernama-Kyodo) -- The Japanese government on Monday launched a new agency to oversee its response to disasters in the quake-prone country and prepare damage reduction measures for a myriad of crises, Kyodo News reported.
